fields.formulaExpression:
case 
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='00'then'NO Match'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='01'then'Found COA: Foreign Move'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='02'then'Found COA: Moved Left No Address'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='03'then'Found COA: Box Closed No Order'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='04'then'Cannot match COA: Street Address with Secondary'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='05'then'Found COA: New 11-digit DPBC is Ambiguous'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='06'then'Cannot Match COA: Conflicting Directions: Middle Name Related'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='07'then'Cannot Match COA: Conflicting Directions: Gender Related'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='08'then'Cannot Match COA: Other Conflicting Instructions'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='09'then'Cannot Match COA: High-rise Default'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='10'then'Cannot Match COA: Rural Default'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='11'then'Cannot Match COA: Individual Match'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='12'then'Cannot Match COA: Middle Name Test Failed'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='13'then'Cannot Match COA: Gender Test Failed'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='14'then'Found COA: New Address Would Not Convert at Run Time'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='15'then'Cannot Match COA: Individual Name Insufficient'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='16'then'Cannot Match COA: Secondary Number Discrepancy'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='17'then'Cannot Match COA: Other Insufficient Name'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='18'then'Cannot Match COA: General Delivery'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='19'then'Found COA: New Address not ZIP + 4 coded'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='66'then'Daily Delete'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='91'then'COA Match: Secondary Number dropped from COA'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='92'then'COA Match: Secondary Number Dropped from input address'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='A'then'COA Match'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='B'then'Match, PO Box closed with no new address.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='D'then'Match, forwarding address is pending deletion.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='F'then'Match, foreign move, no new address.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='K'then'Match, moved but left no address.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='M'then'Match, new address available.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='N'then'No match, no new address available.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='P'then'Possible match, unable to provide new address.'
when "InstantAddBatchProcessed.instantaddress__ReturnCode__c"='T'then'Match, forwarding address is not DPV confirmed.'
else ''
end
